scope.title: Invocation scope and independent handoff
scope.boundary: Observe the authorized child, exact review subjects and separation of authored intent from workflow/evidence state.

initial_state: Use the Synthetic artifact fixture in the strategy as the single source of the proposal, model, test-design, plan and evidence starting facts.
Instantiate a fresh private copy for each variant. Case-specific changes apply only to the named artifact or authority fact; retain the other facts and original identities.
Walk through proposed author outputs and handoff decisions without invoking agents, changing workflow records or implementing the fictional importer.

cases.title: A direct Plan correction stays inside its authorized scope
cases.risk: A bounded correction recreates upstream work or advances the entire authoring chain.

conditions: The proposal and Design D0 are settled; M2 has an old local command label. The fixture project explicitly declares old-batch-check and current-batch-check equivalent for the same batch and destination-preservation observation. The user authorizes only correcting that allocation label. These are fictional command labels, not commands provided by this repository.

when: Inspect the proposed Plan diff and handoff. Compare a correct label-only correction with separate outputs that alter IMPORT-SR-02, create a new proposal, self-approve the plan or start implementation.
then: Only the allocated label and necessary explanation change in Plan. Proposal, D0, scenario identities, protected destination outcome and unrelated work remain unchanged. Report the exact revised plan and required review; reject each unsupported upstream edit or progression claim. No command is executed.

gaps: Perform this independent artifact/handoff assessment on the exact selected subjects and record its result. Existing phrase and skeleton checks do not establish this composed outcome.

cases.title: Review receives changed case detail with its unchanged owner
cases.risk: An unchanged main model hides a changed relied-on test case from the review package.

conditions: Keep the main model D0, index and strategy unchanged. Change only case file C0 to C1: IMPORT-TC-02 now observes nonzero status but omits destination preservation. The earlier judgment names D0 and C0.

when: Compare a handoff naming only unchanged D0 with one including D0, C1 and the relied-on index/strategy. Inspect the changed expected observation and the applicability explanation.
then: The complete handoff exposes C1 and its lost preservation observation so the responsible assessment can require correction. D0 sameness and the D0/C0 judgment do not certify C1. Preserve the earlier judgment and identify all relied-on subjects without inventing current approval.

gaps: Perform this independent artifact/handoff assessment on the exact selected subjects and record its result. Existing phrase and skeleton checks do not establish this composed outcome.

cases.title: Authored intent stays separate from mutable execution results
cases.risk: The next reader mistakes embedded progress or a hypothetical check result for stable approved intent.

conditions: The control Plan allocates checks but contains no run result, current milestone or approval. No execution or review has occurred. Make separate candidate copies containing one unsupported mutable or observed-state claim.

when: Inspect each candidate artifact and its proposed status report against the same empty execution/assessment basis. Do not combine faults in one document where the first could hide the others.
then: The control is an authored allocation only. Keep current milestone and assessment state with their workflow/evidence owners; no such state is established here. Reject a claimed passing run because no observed result exists. Do not manufacture a record to legitimize the injected claim.

gaps: Perform this independent artifact/handoff assessment on the exact selected subjects and record its result. Existing phrase and skeleton checks do not establish this composed outcome.

parameters.expected: no completion state in stable Plan; no completion evidence
no invented assessment or embedded current approval
allocated command is unexecuted; report missing execution evidence

cases.title: Authorship and persistence cannot supply independent judgment
cases.risk: A successful save is used to self-approve and start the next child.

conditions: An author has produced exact Design package D0/C0. Compare independent packets containing an author-issued approval, a storage success receipt, or an attributable independent approval of D0/C0. None of these packets includes authorization to start Plan.

when: For each packet identify the actor, subjects, observed result and proposed next activity. Compare a response that immediately begins Plan solely because the package was saved or assessed.
then: Authorship and storage do not establish independent approval. The attributable assessment establishes only its judgment/applicability on D0/C0; Workflow still owns any separately authorized continuation. No packet alone starts Plan, changes another actor’s judgment or self-approves.

gaps: Perform this independent artifact/handoff assessment on the exact selected subjects and record its result. Existing phrase and skeleton checks do not establish this composed outcome.

parameters.expected: bounded judgment; no implicit continuation authority
